description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). Table XI (ID primary key, non-unique indexes on N and on G) with rows (ID, N, G) inserted (5, 3, 1), (2, 7, 2), (8, 1, 1), (1, 6, 2), (7, 4, 1), (3, 8, 2), (6, 2, 1), (4, 5, 2) and s 'r1' to 'r8' in insertion order. Dynasets over the table name, SELECT ID, s FROM XI; SELECT ID, s FROM XI WHERE N >= 3; SELECT ID, s FROM XI WHERE G = 1; SELECT ID, s FROM XI WHERE s <> 'r4'; SELECT ID, s FROM XI WHERE ID > 2; then snapshots of the WHERE N >= 3 and WHERE s <> 'r4' statements as controls. Asks whether an unordered dynaset comes in storage order, primary-key order, or the order of an index on the WHERE column.
